by
  intro f g a u hf hd hg
  have hc : ContinuousAt (Function.update g a u) a := continuousAt_update_same.2 hg
  have := hasDerivAt_of_hasDerivAt_of_ne (g := Function.update g a u) (x := a)
    (fun y hy => by rw [Function.update_of_ne hy]; exact hd y hy) hf hc
  simpa using this
